note: You survived Halloween 🎃✅ Today is recovery day: lots of water, no leftover candy between meals, and a good floss tonight. Welcome to November twin 🍂🦷

meals: Post-Halloween reset: fluffy cottage cheese pancakes (no syrup, top with fresh strawberries), a glass of milk
Cheddar cubes and crunchy snap peas, then water
Vietnamese fresh spring rolls with shrimp, lettuce and herbs, peanut dipping sauce, chicken pho on the side
Slow-roasted beef brisket, mashed potatoes and roasted carrots. If any Halloween chocolate is left, one or two pieces right after dinner, then cheese and water
days.tip: Leftover candy? Keep it in the kitchen, not your room. Out of sight means no sneaky snack attacks.

meals: Congee (jok) with minced pork, ginger and a soft-boiled egg, a glass of milk
Italian chicken parmesan with spaghetti and steamed broccoli
Salted edamame and a handful of almonds, water
Thai grilled sea bass (pla pao) with herbs, sticky rice and stir-fried morning glory. A few slices of mango right after dinner
days.tip: New month, new toothbrush check: if the bristles are bent out, ask for a new one. Every 3 months is the rule.

meals: Smoked salmon and cream cheese on a toasted whole grain bagel, cucumber slices, a glass of milk
Plain Greek yogurt with crushed pistachios
Japanese chicken katsu with shredded cabbage, rice and miso soup
Celery and carrot sticks with hummus, water
Thai tom kha gai (coconut chicken soup) with jasmine rice and a fried egg. A small bowl of coconut ice cream right after
days.tip: Floss before the night brush, not after. Flossing loosens the gunk, then brushing sweeps it away.
